headline: Public hearings on a 32 units residential development on NS Fernbank Road, a digital billboard at 2100 Roosevelt Avenue, and zoning changes.
summary: Items include an informational report on the New Springfield Housing and Neighborhood Revitalization Plan and a resolution asking to keep One Million Dollars for city housing. Permit changes for motor vehicle sales at 139 Paramount Street and 47 Colton Street are also on the list.
items: Informational: The New Springfield Housing and Neighborhood Revitalization Plan
Resolution urging the Massachusetts Economic Development Bond Bill Conference Committee to retain One Million Dollars in funding for the City of Springfield Housing Strategy
Special permit to amend an existing motor vehicle sales permit at 139 Paramount Street
Special permit for a residential development of 32 units on NS Fernbank Road
Amending three special permits at 47 Colton Street (motor vehicle sales, repairs, and autobody) and changing the petitioner
Special permit for a digital billboard at 2100 Roosevelt Avenue
Zone change for NS Fernbank Road from Residence B and Business A to Residence C
Amending Springfield Zoning Ordinance Articles 2, 4, 5, 7, and 9
